confirmation_rule: remaining unused BETA S1..S70 after v2-v10 roles; SHA256(v11-one-shot-support:filename) ascending; all four reserved
supports: for each subject, choose exactly one full original trial per 0..7 class from one BETA block; query is other three blocks; rotate support block 0..3
template_cca: squared canonical correlation between independently 6-90Hz filtered and channel-standardized query and support at matched common length; no fitted spatial weights
fusion: class-wise z-score per query, then (1-weight)*FBCCA + weight*template_cca; weights fixed at 0.25 or 0.50
selection: subject-macro accuracy over dev, tie in listed order; need >=2 percentage points over fbcca
promotion: new BETA subject-macro gain >=2 percentage points and at least 3/4 subjects nonnegative; otherwise v9 remains default
evaluation_only: D1/D2 never used as support, train, validation or confirmation; do not evaluate calibration on them
inference_scope: same subject/group support and query only, one labeled support per class, no query labels
